title: Defiant Go-Kart Driver's 'High Voltage' Encounter with the Law!
description:
On February 20th, 2023, at around 6:51 pm, a deputy in Florida was on patrol when he saw a black “go-cart” with no lights make a sharp turn and drive past the stop sign. The deputy activated his emergency lights to begin pulling the driver over.
